Granite Warehouse, based at Unit D4, The Yard, on Lynnwood Road in Equestria, supplies and fabricates stone surfaces for kitchen and other countertop installations across Pretoria. Its showroom presents more than 200 colour options across several stone ranges, including natural granite, Caesarstone engineered quartz, ProQuartz, and its own Signature Stone Quartz line, giving customers a range of finishes and price points to compare in a single showroom visit. The business operates as both a retail showroom and a fabrication supplier, meaning customers can select a slab or sample in Equestria and have the same company handle cutting and installation for their project.

Its location on Lynnwood Road in Equestria places it within convenient reach of the surrounding eastern Pretoria suburbs for countertop and renovation customers. Prospective buyers typically start with an on-site or showroom quote before selecting a stone type, a standard part of the company's sales process for granite, quartz and engineered-stone countertops.

H W Theron Incorporated, based in Monument Park, is an attorneys' firm formed in January 2009. The practice began by partnering with Gouws Attorneys, building early experience in delictual claims, corporate recovery claims and Road Accident Fund matters. It has since broadened into a general litigation practice while keeping that claims background as part of its focus, and has partnered with Dreyer and Dreyer Attorneys to extend its range of services. The firm's practice areas include contract law, criminal matters, family and divorce law, estate planning, evictions, general litigation, motor vehicle accident claims, and property law and conveyancing. A distinguishing feature of the practice is its client service portal, which lets clients log in to track the progress of their claims online and receive automatic updates rather than relying solely on phone or correspondence, with the system continuing to be refined.

Based in Monument Park, the firm is positioned to serve clients across the greater Pretoria area who need litigation, conveyancing or family law assistance, drawing on the claims background built up since its founding.

Hannay's Sauces is a family-run gourmet condiment maker based in Queenswood, producing a range of 16 speciality sauces and pestos inspired by flavours from around the world but made locally. The family behind the business spent several decades working in the hospitality industry across numerous countries before channelling that experience into developing its own product range, which it has now been making for just over twelve years. Products include an Argentinian-style chimichurri, a herb-based pesto that can be melted into butter for steak, thinned with olive oil and lemon juice as a dressing, or used as a sandwich spread, alongside chilli oil, sun-dried tomato and olive pesto, and harissa.

All sauces are made with fresh herbs and only quality ingredients, with no artificial preservatives, colourants or additives; the pestos are made with extra virgin olive oil. The range is Halal compliant, vegan-friendly, vegetarian and free of nuts, with the exception of a rum syrup variant that contains alcohol. Sauces are sold in 300ml glass bottles and supplied to several retailers as well as more than 20 local markets across South Africa.

Heindo Waterproofing & Steel Works is a general maintenance and construction business operating from Jopie Fourie Street in Pretoria North, in the Wolmer area. The business covers a broad range of home maintenance and building trades, including painting, waterproofing, guttering and ceiling work, together with steel works, wooden decking, plumbing, tiling and general building. A 2020 update from the business described waterproofing and painting work on tile, zinc and concrete roofs, indicating that roof waterproofing is one of its regular jobs alongside its other maintenance trades. By combining painting, waterproofing, plumbing, tiling, steel work and general building services under one contractor, the business is positioned to take on multi-trade maintenance and small renovation jobs for Pretoria North area homeowners without requiring them to source separate specialists for each task.

Its Jopie Fourie Street base keeps it within easy reach of surrounding Pretoria North suburbs for this type of maintenance and small-scale construction work.

Home Builders Pretoria, trading as Pretoria Builders from its Heatherview base in Pretoria North, is a construction company offering home restoration and renovation, brick laying, dry walling and plastering, home improvements and extensions, new home building, and loft and basement conversions. Its dry wall and plastering team supplies and installs partition walls as part of new builds and extensions, or to create additional usable space within an existing home, while its brick-laying crews handle structural work for new builds and additions. The company describes itself as one of the premier construction firms operating in Gauteng, and lists coverage across Pretoria's City Centre, the central-western suburbs of Danville and Mountain View, the south-eastern suburbs of Newlands, Lynnwood, Hatfield and Menlo Park, the north-eastern suburbs of Silverton and Bellevue, the north-western suburb of Rosslyn, and Centurion.

Operating from Heatherview in Pretoria North gives the business a central base from which to service this wide spread of areas, offering free building quotations for home renovation, extension and new-build projects.

House of Pools, based in Doornpoort, designs, builds, renovates and repairs swimming pools for customers across Pretoria and the wider Gauteng region. Its service range covers custom-designed pools built around a client's available space, lifestyle and budget, as well as fibreglass pools, which offer a smooth, low-maintenance finish with a quicker installation process than fully built pools. For properties with a view, the company also builds infinity pools designed to create a seamless, luxury appearance for outdoor entertaining areas.

Beyond new pool construction, House of Pools carries out pool renovations to refresh the look and restore the functionality of existing pools, and offers automated pool deck solutions intended to maximise usable space, improve safety and add a premium finish around the pool area. Its pool paving service completes these projects with durable, practical paving finishes suited to high-traffic outdoor areas. The company offers free on-site quotations for prospective clients, assessing a property in person before recommending a pool type and finish suited to the available space and the client's design preferences.

HOWES' DESIGNS, based in Constantia Park, is a building contractor specialising in home and commercial renovations and additions, drawing on 25 years of building experience. The company organises its work around precise project planning, aiming to balance design ambition with practicality and cost for each renovation project it takes on. Recent and completed projects listed by the company include the Capito Restaurant renovation, a renovation and additions project in the South Downs Estate, and a renovation in Radcliffe, Waterkloof, illustrating a mix of residential and commercial work. The company frames its value proposition around the idea that a client's home or office is typically their most significant asset, and that renovation and building decisions should be approached with a dependable, experienced partner rather than treated lightly. Services cover the design and drawing of building plans as well as the management and execution of the renovation or addition itself, from initial concept through to completed project.

Based in Constantia Park, the business is positioned to serve renovation clients across the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs it has already completed projects in, such as Waterkloof.

I Love My Smile is a dental practice in Lynnwood offering a full range of dental services from a single, modern facility. The practice's offering spans oral hygiene and teeth whitening, routine dental cleaning, and treatment for gum infections and mouth sores, through to general dentistry procedures such as wisdom teeth extraction, dental fillings and dental extractions. It also provides endodontic treatment, including root canal therapy, and prosthodontic services for patients needing more complex restorative dental work. The practice presents itself as a destination for both preventive and corrective dental care, aiming to support patients through routine check-ups as well as more involved procedures within the same clinic.

Based in Lynnwood, the practice serves patients from across the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs who are looking for a single dental provider covering hygiene, general dentistry, root canal treatment and prosthodontics, reducing the need to be referred elsewhere for more specialised restorative work.

Impact Energy, based in La Montagne, is a solar and renewable energy company offering solar power solutions, solar geysers and solar-powered water backup systems to residential and business customers. The company organises its work around tailoring each installation to the specific site and needs of the client rather than offering a single standard system, with its team drawing on years of experience in the renewable energy industry to specify, install and optimise systems for efficiency and longevity. Its core offering centres on solar energy systems that harness the sun's power to provide clean, renewable electricity, complemented by solar geysers for water heating and solar-powered backup and filtration systems that keep water supply running during outages.

Based in La Montagne, in eastern Pretoria, the company serves clients looking to reduce reliance on the municipal grid and water supply through a combination of solar power, solar water heating and backup water systems installed and supported by its own technical team.

Imvusa Projects, based in Booysens, is a specialist contractor serving the petroleum, commercial and residential construction sectors. Its core focus is the maintenance and construction of retail fuel facilities, alongside small to large-scale industrial, commercial and private building works, demolition, and civil and structural engineering projects. The company's service range extends beyond general building and maintenance to include plumbing, structural and roofing work, civils, plant and equipment hire, land-clearing and demolition, consulting engineering support, CCTV pipeline camera inspections, and specialised glazing solutions. Imvusa Projects treats safety compliance as a central part of its operations, stating that it follows the safety requirements and legislation set out for the construction industry as public and private sector clients increasingly require contractors committed to zero-harm working environments.

By combining fuel-facility expertise with broader commercial and residential building capability, the company is able to take on specialised petroleum-sector maintenance work as well as standard construction and demolition projects from its Booysens base.

InCase Self Storage Pretoria East, based in Salieshoek, is part of a multi-branch self-storage network with locations across Buh-Rein, Pretoria North, Pretoria East, Somerset West, Roodepoort and Midrand. The Pretoria East branch offers storage units ranging from space for a few boxes up to full-house moves, along with secure carport rental for vehicles, trailers and boats. The company markets its units around three priorities: affordability, through competitive pricing at a convenient location; safety, with fire safety treated as a top priority in unit design; and security, with the site monitored to protect stored belongings, while customers use their own padlock to control access to their individual unit.

This combination is aimed at customers going through a house move, decluttering a home, or needing extra space for vehicles and outdoor equipment without committing to a long-term lease elsewhere. Being part of a larger storage group gives the Salieshoek branch the backing of an established self-storage operator with facilities across multiple parts of Gauteng.

INDUSNET, based in Ashley Gardens, is a business and technology consulting firm describing its role as bridging the gap between business and technology. Its service begins with structured business analysis and process mapping, using established methodologies to ensure that business requirements are correctly defined and that business expectations remain the guiding thread throughout a project. From there, the firm works on solution architecture and alignment, selecting technology architecture intended to serve a client's business objectives over a three-, five- or seven-year lifespan, while remaining independent of any single product or vendor.

Indusnet also offers project identification, management and execution, supplying technology-focused project resources to implement the agreed solution, and operational optimisation and cost management services aimed at ensuring new technology is fully operational before it goes live. Clients can engage the firm's resources either as permanent staff who become part of the business's own overhead, or as private contractors engaged on a fixed-term contract basis, giving companies flexibility in how they resource a technology project from its Ashley Gardens base.

Iqra Shop Fitter is a shop-fitting and bespoke carpentry business based in Laudium, serving customers across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area. The team works on custom shop-fitting designs and carpentry, handling everything from initial design through to precise installation for retail and commercial spaces. Its focus is on durable, professionally finished fittings rather than generic off-the-shelf shop furniture, with each job built around the specific layout and branding needs of the client's premises.

Operating from Unit 3 at 385 2nd Avenue in Laudium, the business is open Monday to Saturday, giving it availability beyond typical weekday-only trading hours for clients coordinating shop fit-outs around their own business schedules. By combining local knowledge of the Centurion and Laudium trade environment with hands-on carpentry skill, Iqra Shop Fitter positions itself as a dependable choice for retailers and commercial tenants needing custom-built fittings, shelving and fixtures installed to a professional standard.

items.description:
it-so-easy is an IT support company based in Wonderboom South offering a broad range of desktop, network and business-technology services. Its remote support service aims to keep downtime to a minimum, resolving most desktop issues without needing an on-site visit, while its offsite backup offering includes multiple solutions such as physical USB data drive swaps for clients who want a tangible, rotating backup alongside any cloud option. For security, the company partners with ESET to provide antivirus and ransomware protection suited to different business scenarios.

Beyond support services, it-so-easy sells hardware including printers, laptops, netbooks, desktops and servers, alongside software, and offers a range of competitively priced hosting packages backed by its own support team. The company also provides sales and support for Pastel accounting software, positioning itself as a specialist resource for businesses running Pastel who need both the software and technical backup to keep it running. Based in Wonderboom South, the business serves small and medium companies in the area needing IT support, hardware supply and hosting from a single local provider.

Jacques Booysen Seminars, based in Rietfontein, runs structured personal development and life-coaching programmes for both individuals and corporate clients. Its flagship offering is a 'Get a Life' programme delivered over 40 days, built around seven strategic questions designed to prompt participants to rethink different aspects of their lives and realign their priorities, rather than simply reinforcing existing habits. The business also makes use of Shadowmatch, a behavioural assessment tool, as part of its coaching toolkit. Coaching areas covered include general life coaching and relationship coaching for individual clients.

For corporate clients, the seminars are positioned as an intervention tool, used by sales teams and executive teams to become more focused and productive, applying the same structured questioning approach used in the individual programme to a workplace context. Based in Rietfontein, the business works with clients seeking a structured, multi-week process for personal change rather than a single one-off coaching session, combining its question-based framework with the Shadowmatch assessment to guide participants toward specific changes.

Jenkins Inc Attorneys, based in Rietondale, is a law firm built around personal, client-focused service, with an open-door policy that accepts client communication outside standard business hours. The firm treats family law as a particular area of focus, offering a comprehensive divorce and family law service that includes contested and uncontested divorce, Rule 43 applications, maintenance claims and enforcement, general mediation, primary care and contact arrangements, drafting of parental plans, adoption and guardianship applications, parental rights and responsibilities matters, surrogacy matters, curatorship applications, partnership agreements, division of estates, and domestic violence and protection order applications. Alongside its family law practice, Jenkins Inc Attorneys handles civil law matters, including High Court and Magistrate's Court litigation, defamation claims, damages and negligence claims, delictual matters, and the drafting of contracts.

The firm describes itself as acting quickly and efficiently from the moment instructions are received, aiming to deliver a personal and professional service across this broad family and civil law practice from its Rietondale base.

Jenna Clifford's Lynnwood Bridge boutique is part of a family-owned fine jewellery company established in South Africa in 1992. For more than three decades the brand has designed and crafted jewellery intended to be worn often and eventually passed on, ranging from delicate, everyday pieces to one-of-a-kind statement jewels. The Lynnwood Bridge store offers the brand's fine jewellery collections alongside its bespoke custom design service, through which customers can commission a piece designed specifically for them, and a remodelling service for reworking existing jewellery, such as inherited pieces, into a new design.

Engagement rings form a specific part of the collection, reflecting the brand's positioning as a destination for diamond jewellery in particular. Beyond jewellery, the brand has also extended into homeware items sold alongside its jewellery ranges. Customers can book a design appointment at the Lynnwood Bridge boutique to discuss a bespoke or remodelling project directly with the brand's design team, making the Lynnwood Manor store one of the brand's points of access for its custom jewellery design services in Pretoria.

JMC Centurion, trading as Lazarus JMC Centurion, is a franchised JMC vehicle dealership in Clubview operated by Lazarus Motor Company, a dealer group whose own marketing points to four generations and six decades of operating history. The dealership sells new JMC vehicles alongside demonstrator models and special deals for buyers comparing trim levels and pricing. Alongside sales, it operates a service department for scheduled maintenance and repairs, a genuine parts counter, and a dedicated smart repair and fitment centre for bodywork and accessory fitment. The dealership also offers a vehicle valuation service for customers wanting to trade in or sell a current vehicle, and in-house financial services to support vehicle finance applications.

Based in Clubview, the dealership serves JMC buyers across Centurion and the surrounding Pretoria area, combining new-vehicle sales with the full range of after-sales services, from parts and servicing through to valuations and finance, under the backing of the longer-established Lazarus Motor Company dealer group.

Johnlee Properties, based in Murrayfield, is a property rental agency offering an online system through which landlords can list a property to rent and prospective tenants can apply to rent a property, without needing to visit the office in person to start the process. The agency treats property rental management as requiring a dedicated skill set, framing its role as helping landlords build a property portfolio geared toward long-term financial goals such as retirement, rather than simply filling vacancies. It describes its approach as pioneering its own methods and systems for matching tenants to properties and managing rentals, rather than following industry norms by default.

Based in Murrayfield, the agency works with landlords across the surrounding Pretoria East area who want their rental property actively managed, and with tenants searching for available rental housing through its online application process.

Just Property Midstream Estate is a real estate office operating under the Just Property franchise network from Midlands Office Park in Midstream Estate. The branch is registered with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority and describes itself as a well-known, dynamic presence within the Midstream Estate community specifically. Its services cover rental management for landlords, property valuations for owners wanting to establish a property's current market worth, and a broader range of sales and letting services for buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords operating within the estate.

Being based inside Midstream Estate itself, rather than simply servicing the area from further away, gives the branch direct, on-the-ground familiarity with the estate's property stock and the specific rules, levies and considerations that come with living in a managed residential estate. This makes the office a point of contact for Midstream Estate residents dealing with residential sales, letting, rental management or property valuation needs within the estate.

Just Property Montana has operated from the Magalieskruin Shopping Centre since opening in October 2004, making it one of the longer-established branches in the Just Property franchise network in Pretoria. The branch's coverage area spans Annlin, Sinoville, Doornpoort, Montana, Montana Park, Wonderboom and Magalieskruin, and its services span residential property sales and rentals across these northern Pretoria suburbs. Having traded in the same part of the city for more than two decades, the branch has built up an extended track record in these specific suburbs, which supports its work advising both buyers and sellers on local property values and helping landlords find and manage tenants.

Based inside the Magalieskruin Shopping Centre, the office is positioned within one of its core service suburbs, giving local residents walk-in access to a property practitioner without needing to travel to a separate commercial district.

Kai Thai Spa Erasmia is the Erasmia branch of a Gauteng-wide Kai Thai Spa network that also operates locations in Moreleta Park, Centurion, Midrand, Alberton and Randburg. The spa offers massage and beauty treatments built around a Thai-inspired approach to relaxation, alongside a facials menu that includes deep-cleanse and Vitamin C facial treatments and a combined manicure-and-pedicure service. Its waxing menu covers half and full arm, half and full leg, Hollywood, back and stomach waxing for clients booking grooming treatments alongside massage or facial appointments. Gift vouchers are available for clients wanting to book treatments as a present for someone else.

Being one branch within a larger six-location Gauteng group gives the Erasmia spa the benefit of standardised treatment menus and booking systems used across the group's other locations, while still operating from its own premises on Willem Erasmus Street in Erasmia to serve clients in that part of Centurion.

Kalahari Coffee is a coffee roaster based in Donkerhoek that has been roasting and selling coffee since 2020, drawing its name and branding from the Kalahari region. Each batch is freshly roasted to order and packed in sustainable, eco-friendly packaging to preserve flavour on delivery, with the range including organic options and a CO2-decaffeinated blend alongside its standard beans. Individual blends are named after Kalahari animals: Bush Baby, a medium roast made from an organically certified bean with cocoa powder and almond aromas in a soft, balanced cup and the company's best seller; Meerkat, a bean grown without significant use of pesticides or fertilisers though not independently organic-certified, which can be blended with Bush Baby for a different flavour profile; and Gecko, a medium-dark roast with a dark chocolatey aroma, spicy notes and mild acidity.

Alongside its online store, the company supplies coffee for events, bringing its brewing and blends to functions rather than only selling packaged beans. The business has also moved toward fabric packaging as part of a broader shift toward more environmentally friendly materials.

Khentsa Steel, operating from Klerksoord under its Khentsa Specialized Tube product line, manufactures thermal and oxygen lancing tubes supplied to industrial customers both locally and internationally. Alongside its core lancing tube products, the company supplies a comprehensive range of related lancing equipment and accessories, including ball valves for precise flow control, which use a spherical disc design to regulate fluid flow reliably across different industrial applications, as well as braided hoses and fire-resistant personal protective equipment for workers handling lancing and cutting equipment. The company treats continuous innovation in its production processes as central to its operations, alongside a stated focus on environmental preservation and social responsibility in how it runs its manufacturing operation.

Based in the Jobeth Industrial Park in Klerksoord, Akasia, the business supplies industries that rely on thermal and oxygen lancing for cutting and demolition work, combining its tube manufacturing with the valves, hoses and protective equipment needed to operate that equipment safely.

Knife Machines Tools and Supplies cc, trading as KMTS from Akasia, supplies materials, machines and tools for knife-making alongside running its own knife-making courses and a laser-cutting service. Its catalogue covers the full range of components a knife-maker needs, including steel blanks and kits, handle materials, leather and Kydex for sheaths and grips, abrasives and sanding paper, polishing supplies, glue and chemicals, filing tools, and engineering screws and components, as well as machines, tools and accessories and pouches and cases for finished knives. Its hands-on courses are run in small groups for personalised instruction, taking participants from basic knife-making techniques through to more advanced metalwork skills, with all materials and tools provided and each participant taking home a knife they have made by the end of the course. The laser-cutting service offers precision cutting for custom blade designs, intricate patterns and specialised shapes, giving knife-makers a way to add detailed custom elements to their blades without needing their own laser equipment.

Based in Akasia, the business serves both hobbyist and more experienced knife-makers across its supplies, courses and cutting-service offering.

Labour Direct, based in Ashley Gardens, is an industrial relations consultancy that helps employers manage the legal and procedural risks that come with employing staff in South Africa. The consultancy's starting point is that, without specialised labour law assistance, employers can easily find themselves in costly legal disputes with employees or trade unions, exposing the business to significant financial risk. It assists employers facing recurring workplace problems such as limited productivity, poor work performance and other labour-related disputes, helping them apply correct procedures rather than relying on guesswork when a problem arises. The consultancy frames its core service as protection, helping business owners understand the urgency of addressing labour issues correctly and recognising that a mishandled labour incident can affect not only the business itself but also the people connected to it.

Based in Ashley Gardens, Labour Direct works with employers across the greater Pretoria area who need guidance on disciplinary processes, union engagement and other labour law compliance matters rather than facing them without dedicated support.

Laffies Gear, based in Midstream Ridge, is a sports equipment retailer stocking footwear and gear across several sports categories, from court shoes through to off-road running shoes. Its racquet sports range covers pickleball, padel and tennis, stocking both racquets and supporting accessories such as dampeners, overgrips and grommets, while a separate equipment range covers swimming, cricket, rugby and other general sports needs. The shop carries established international sports brands including Wilson, Babolat and HEAD, stocking items such as junior tennis racquets, padel frame protectors and padel balls alongside more everyday accessories like grips and dampeners.

Operating from the Square @ Midstream shopping centre, the store serves the Midstream Estate area and surrounding Centurion suburbs, giving local players of tennis, padel and other racquet sports access to specialist equipment and accessories without needing to travel into central Pretoria or Johannesburg for brand-name sports gear.

Land Rover Centurion is a franchised Land Rover dealership on West Avenue in Centurion, offering new vehicle sales, an approved pre-owned programme, parts and accessories, and test drives. Its new-vehicle range includes the Range Rover, available with plug-in hybrid and mild hybrid options, and the Land Rover Defender family, offered in 90, 110 and 130 model variants to suit different space and capability needs. The dealership's approved pre-owned programme gives buyers access to inspected used Land Rover vehicles as an alternative to buying new, while its parts and accessories range lets existing owners complement their vehicle's style and performance with manufacturer-approved extras. A dedicated service department handles scheduled maintenance and repair work for Land Rover owners, with technicians trained specifically on the brand's vehicles.

Based on West Avenue in Centurion, the dealership serves Land Rover owners and prospective buyers across Centurion and the southern Pretoria area, combining new and used vehicle sales with ongoing parts and service support.

Leona Corporate South Africa, trading as L.E.C.S.A Consulting from Andeon, is a financial services firm offering a broad range of accounting, tax and business-advisory services. Its core offering includes tax services, bookkeeping, financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements, alongside payroll services and support with new company registrations. Beyond routine accounting work, the firm also provides enterprise risk management and business continuity planning services, helping clients formulate internal controls intended to protect a business against operational and compliance risks. It runs basic and advanced compliance training as well as financial literacy training courses, and offers supply chain management services for clients needing support beyond pure accounting and tax compliance.

The firm centres its approach on open communication with clients throughout a project and describes its team as well-qualified across these different financial and advisory disciplines. Based in Andeon, the business serves clients across Pretoria needing combined accounting, tax, risk and compliance support from a single financial services provider rather than engaging separate specialists for each service.

LHC Pharmaceuticals (Pty) Ltd, based in Willow Park Manor, is a South African pharmaceutical manufacturer focused on generic, biosimilar and innovative medicines. The company is licensed by the South African Health Products Regulatory Authority as a Marketing Authorisation Holder, and holds what it describes as the largest Black-owned SAHPRA dossier portfolio in Southern Africa, spanning more than 70 registered SAHPRA product lines. NEHAWU Investment Holdings holds a shareholding in the company, and LHC Pharmaceuticals has an exclusive strategic partnership with KRKA, a major international pharmaceutical manufacturer, supporting its generic and biosimilar medicine offering. Trading under the banner 'One Health, One Ecosystem', the company positions itself within the broader South African healthcare supply chain as a locally based manufacturer and dossier holder rather than solely an importer or distributor of medicines.

Based at the N4 Gateway Industrial Park in Willow Park Manor, the company's scale of SAHPRA registrations and its KRKA partnership position it as one of the more established Black-owned pharmaceutical manufacturing businesses operating out of Pretoria.

Logon IT Store operates two retail branches, in Moreleta Park and Monument Park, offering in-store IT hardware and software sales alongside upgrades, repairs and software installations. The Monument Park branch forms part of a small, specialised team structure, with staff responsible for sales, networking and CCTV installation, a dedicated software specialist handling Microsoft products, domain management and hosted Exchange email, and separate technical sales and support staff covering wireless networking and day-to-day customer support. Beyond walk-in retail sales and repairs, the business offers broader IT business solutions aimed at improving and increasing a client's productivity by optimising their hardware, software and support arrangements, with the company describing its approach as tailor-made to each business's specific requirements rather than a standard package applied to every client.

Based in Monument Park, the store gives local businesses and residents access to hardware purchases, PC repairs and networking or CCTV installation support, backed by the group's second branch in Moreleta Park.

Luminous Entourage, based in Annlin, offers end-to-end real estate services covering the buying, selling and renting of residential property. Its team provides guided support throughout a transaction along with detailed market analysis, intended to give clients a realistic picture of pricing and demand before they commit to a sale, purchase or rental agreement. The agency describes accuracy, transparency and client satisfaction as the priorities underpinning its approach to each property transaction it handles. Its Annlin premises include wheelchair-accessible parking, a practical consideration for clients visiting the office in person to discuss a listing or rental application.

Based in Annlin West, the agency works with buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants across the surrounding northern Pretoria suburbs, offering personalised solutions tailored to each client's specific property goals rather than a single standard service package for every transaction.

M Productions, operating out of Lyttelton in Centurion, is a technical event production company that has spent more than 20 years engineering complex productions for corporate, broadcast, sporting and live entertainment clients across Southern Africa. The company describes itself as Sub-Saharan Africa's largest high-power laser display company, operating what it says is the largest array of high-power professional display lasers in the sub-Saharan region, supported by its own in-house laser inventory, advanced control systems and experienced laser operators. Its laser productions are built for stadium-scale and broadcast-ready events, with each deployment engineered around advanced beam control and mapping, redundant safety systems, and internationally aligned operating standards, reflecting the regulatory compliance expected for high-power laser use at public events. Beyond laser displays, the company's technical production work extends to sound, lighting design, AV and LED displays, stage and set design, and broadcast or live-streaming support for events.

Based in Lyttelton, M Productions works with event organisers needing reliable, large-scale technical production where safety and consistency are treated as essential parts of the job.

Manhattan Co Working, located in Ashlea Gardens Office Park, offers dedicated desk space and small private offices as an alternative to a traditional office lease or working from home. The space is built around a complete office solution, with a staffed reception that greets visitors and forwards calls on behalf of member businesses, access to boardrooms equipped with video conferencing and projector facilities, and free use of separate meeting rooms for client or team sessions. Members have access to free tea and coffee throughout the day, along with fibre internet and WiFi covering the whole space. The business frames its offering around the broader shift away from strictly traditional offices toward more flexible, shared working environments where members can network with other businesses while still having access to professional meeting and boardroom facilities when needed.

Based in Ashley Gardens, Manhattan Co Working serves small businesses, freelancers and corporate teams in the area looking for flexible office space without the overheads of running a standalone office.

This McDonald's restaurant operates from Jubilee Mall on Harry Gwala Avenue in Hammanskraal, serving the chain's standard menu of burgers, fries and chicken nuggets alongside milkshakes and soft serve. The restaurant emphasises speed and freshness, aiming to serve meals quickly while keeping its dining area clean and welcoming for families. Customers can dine in with a Happy Meal for children, order a coffee at the in-store McCafe counter, or get food quickly through the drive-thru without leaving their car.

Based inside Jubilee Mall, the restaurant forms part of the mall's retail and food offering for Hammanskraal shoppers, giving mall visitors a fast-food option alongside their shopping trip as well as a drive-thru lane for customers passing by without stopping to shop. As with other McDonald's restaurants, the Hammanskraal branch follows the brand's standard food preparation and service approach rather than offering a location-specific menu, though its placement inside Jubilee Mall ties its trade closely to the mall's own footfall.

Mci IT, based in Copperleaf Golf and Country Estate in Centurion, develops laboratory and quality-management software rather than offering general IT services. Its core product is a Laboratory Information Management System built for laboratories across agricultural and seed testing, food testing, mining, analytical and chemical work, microbiology, medical pathology and diagnostics, civil engineering materials testing, and calibration services. The company packages this alongside a Quality Management System and an Asset, Equipment and Inventory Management module as part of an integrated Cloud Solutions Suite, built on a low-code platform so it can be adapted to a laboratory's existing procedures rather than forcing labs to change their own processes to fit the software.

Being cloud-based, the system is accessible from different types of devices wherever there is a data connection, and is designed to work as a centralised system across multiple branches and departments within a single laboratory organisation. The suite also supports third-party integrations, barcode printing and scanning, and digital signatures, giving laboratories a single software platform covering sample and asset tracking, quality compliance and inter-branch coordination from Mci IT's Centurion base.
